event_anchor.freeze_rule: Do not shift the anchor using precipitation peaks, remote-sensing response, or basin outcomes.

hydrologic_identity.rule: Do not delineate a separate Rayos de Sol basin unless independent pre-unblind hydrologic evidence contradicts the pre-2015 Corrales drainage identity.

rainfall_source.sampling: area-weighted over frozen DEM basin polygon; point/seed sampling forbidden once polygon exists

metrics.trigger: total precipitation in each fixed window ending exactly at event_anchor.utc
metrics.antecedent: total precipitation in each fixed antecedent window ending exactly at event_anchor.utc

morphometry_contract.outlet_gate: Explicit confluence/outlet evidence or independent drainage trace required before basin geometry is FROZEN.

a6680_reference.note: Rayos de Sol section contains qualitative morphometry but no numeric morphometric values in the parsed A6680 section.

sealed_sources: A6680 numeric morphometry until DEM morphometry is frozen
allowed_before_unblind: source locators and hashes without outcome extraction
audit_requirements: hash all predictor outputs before unblind
record code SHA, input URLs/identifiers, timestamps and coverage
verify no post-anchor timestamps in rainfall inputs
verify no outcome files were read by predictor jobs
freeze basin geometries and morphometry before revealing A6680 numeric reference values
freeze negative-control candidate pool before any control outcome adjudication

candidate_generation: enumerate neighboring independent drainage units along the Rimac/Santa Eulalia corridor using geography/DEM only
exclude the six target drainage units
freeze candidate pool before reading 2015 territorial evidence
rank only by distance, basin-area ratio, relief ratio and DEM-derived slope similarity
negative_control_contract.control_label_rule: A candidate can be CONTROL only with affirmative independent evidence of no activation during the frozen event window; documentary silence remains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

sources.role: post-freeze susceptibility comparison; national generalized scale, not basin truth
A6680 institutional document locator; source contains UAV/orthomosaic references

sources.title: EVAR por flujo de detritos, area de influencia Rayos de Sol, Carossio y Libertad
sources.role: post-event risk-map comparison only after permitted unblind

known_blockers: Validated hydrologic outlets are not frozen for all six target drainage units; existing Quirio/Pedregal DEM candidate polygons remain REVIEW_ONLY and cannot support final morphometry.

Rayos de Sol is treated as the territorial sector associated with the Corrales drainage under pre-2015 IGP cartography; exact Corrales outlet still requires source/D8 freeze and must not be replaced by a standalone Rayos basin without contradictory independent evidence.
A6680/CENEPRED public document has map imagery but the prior automated extraction produced no usable text coordinates.
Negative-control outcomes are intentionally not adjudicated before the candidate pool is frozen.
